071d0735: ;If X is null, go back to prompt for input unless DV has an "R" piece and the value of DV is not a valid response, or D>0 (DV has been edited). In those cases, branch back to the Reader.
6febe754: ;If X is a question mark, branch to the Question/Help Reader. If X is an up-arrow, execute the DATA command and branch to the Classic Reader.
ecc1bc63: ;If X is an at-sign, execute the DATA command and branch to the DIEZCHANGED Reader.

7e2f18b0: ;If X is a space, DV contains a "d" piece and the "P" piece is not present, and the user's last ID in this field is in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB), set X to that value. If DV does not contain a "D" or "S" piece, write the value of X preceded by two spaces.

dc574dfd: ;If DV contains a "V" piece, branch to the VERIFY Reader; if DV contains an "S" piece, branch to the SPECIAL Reader; otherwise, if DV does not contain a "P" piece, execute the DICOMPUTED code for this field. If there is a Transform on this field and X is not null, execute the Transform if it exists. If there is no DB(DQ) node, write the transformed data preceded by two spaces. Branch to the Validator.
3bfc55d3: If the substring before the colon is the variable X, execute the DIC('S') code and quit if DG is true.
968d7f9f: If DB(DQ) is undefined, write the substring of YS starting from DG to the end. Then set X to the substring before the colon in YS.
667996c0: If DV contains 'P', set DIC and DIC(0) accordingly. If DV doesn't contain '*', call the ^DIC routine, set X to the returned IEN, and set DIC to DIE. Go to X if X is negative.
d5f5a2d3: If DV doesn't contain 'N', call the D subroutine. If the decimal part of X is longer than 24 digits, kill X and go to Z.

c34db6df: If the second comma-piece of DV is true and X contains a decimal point and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) doesn't start with '$', remove leading zeros from X and trailing zeros from the decimal part of X. If X has a decimal point but no decimal part, convert it to an integer.
e17533cf: ;Kill Y(0) and notify caller that file record has been deleted.
7d63ff0c: ;If input value X is defined and not aborted, save X and, if DV was defined, save DUZ subscript of DISV global.
61792b34: ;Unknown input value or invalid Help prompt response.
3509a93d: ;Set X to error message.
a78d66bc: ;When there is a (near) syntax error, get data dictionary field attributes and go to 'B' for manual user prompting.

d267fc1b: ;If there is no DE() array for this field, perform XECUTABLE help and re-prompt. If this is a Multiple and X is NOT '@', branch to 'RD'. If this is not Read-only and X is '@', branch to 'A'. If X is '@' pass control to ^DIEZ.
78148c73: ;If DQ has a screening logic parameter (DQ(DQ,2)), invoke it via X DQ(DQ,2).

55e04229: ;If VARIABLE-POINTER field, get .01 field of pointed-to global into Y. If this references a POINTER file, get pointer type of referenced file into DG and .01 field into X (for looping).
f7eddded: If DG contains 'D', execute ^DD('DD'). If DG contains 'S', retrieve a substring from X based on Y and store it in Y.

18a3cd49: Execute the E^DIE0 routine. If X exists, go to the RD label. Otherwise, go to the PR label.
56833d36: Exit the routine.
